name: Contrast
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Clear for long reading and research notes: near-black on a cool white page, 18 px type, red and navy headings, links always underlined, a firm rule under top headings and code set apart by a border. Body text meets WCAG AAA. Colours after ITS, our own CSS.

zh.description: 长文阅读和研究笔记都清晰：冷白底上的近黑文字，18 px 字号，红色与藏青标题，链接始终带下划线，一级标题下有实线，代码用边框隔开。正文对比度达到 WCAG AAA。配色参考 ITS，CSS 为我们自己编写。
